CustomField.description: ARR contributed by this specific deal. For New Business / Pilot equals Annual_Recurring_Revenue__c (the full extracted amount). For Upsell / Downsell / Contract Restructure / Renewal equals Annual_Recurring_Revenue__c minus the base Opportunity's prior ARR. Null when Base_Opportunity__c is not set or the base has no successful extraction yet.
CustomField.label: Incremental ARR
